Fixtures of `tests/test_runner_node.py` (fenvix-run, Node path). Lockfiles are real (generated by npm, yarn 1 and
pnpm 10) so that `fenvix-run` installs them the way a CI job does (`npm ci`, `yarn install --frozen-lockfile`,
`pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`).

* `vitest-app`: Vitest, npm. `test/registry.test.js::registry::starts empty` is order-dependent (fails after
  `registers a plugin`, passes alone); a duplicated test name (`adds numbers #2`), a skipped and a todo test.
* `jest-app`: Jest, yarn 1. `__tests__/cache.test.js::cache::starts empty` is order-dependent; `a real failure`
  fails alone too.
* `mixed`: a Python package with pytest tests and a Vitest suite (pnpm, `packageManager` pinned): one job per
  language.
